scope: User-approved tiered workflow; different coverage, not equal-workload algorithm benchmark

before.policy: Every UI change required full verify
before.source: P0 recorded mean, baseline source call chain

after.policy: Targeted unit tests plus 390px mobile and 1280px desktop for localized changes only

limitations: Quick intentionally has reduced scope and cannot authorize release, shared layout/core/schema or cross-widget changes.
P0 excludes tool preflight; current full timing includes it and more tests/content guards, so full times are observations, not equal-workload speed measurements.
OS/browser caches were not flushed, background load not controlled; no statistically controlled speedup claimed.

Prepare 4→1 and layout 2→1 refer to one connected release flow; command/code-path tests plus actual verify/payload run establish counts. NSIS was not executed, so end-to-end release speedup is unmeasured.
Cross-run cache reuse and parallel Chromium were intentionally not introduced.
